A '''bunker''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] was used as a hideout for the [[Sif]] faction, a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group under the command of [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Erran Sif]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:ES" />

==History==
{{Quote|The traitor Erran Sif is leading a small group of warriors on Talus. She betrayed the Empire in the past and is considered an enemy, so don't expect a friendly reception. I hear she's also no friend to the Rebel Alliance for whatever that's worth.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Velso]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:LV">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Corellian Corvette Pre-Quest: "Lt. Velso"}}</ref>}}
[[File:Sif.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A group of [[Sif]] mercenaries in the lowest level of the bunker]]
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] Erran Sif was wanted by both the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] for selling information to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. She had thus fled from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to Talus, where she assembled a band of mercenaries.<ref name="10HSTG">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Travel%20Guide|text=10 Hot Spots Travel Guide}}</ref> Erran Sif eventually established her mercenary group, including two brothers [[Hirsch Sif|Hirsch]] and [[Doak Sif]], in the bunker.<ref name="SWG:ES" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Velso]] dispatched a spacer to the Sif bunker in order to retrieve the ship destruct sequence codes of a Rebel [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian Corvette]] in which Erran Sif served during her time among the Rebels.<ref name="SWG:LV" />

The same year, a spacer infiltrated the bunker and stole a [[Lance/Legends|lance]].<ref name="SWG:RMWMII">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rare Melee Weapons Mark II}}</ref>
